title: Writing, Culture, Power
description: Literature and other texts as cultural practices that address colonial power and privilege; emphasizes contemporary English-language texts, primarily by and about members of marginalized communities, on subjects such as indigeneity, settlement, immigration and racialization. Develops foundations in textual and genre analysis and academic argument in relation to decolonial knowledge as well as research skills and APA citation.
notes: This course satisfies the Academic Writing Requirement.
Not recommended for students concurrently registered in ATWP 110 due to credit restrictions. Please refer to the note section of ATWP 110 for more information.
